paragraphs.text: 1. BE with us; I have chosen thee: stand steadfast and immovable.
Let all the people wish for thee let not thy kingship fall away.
paragraphs.original: विशस्त्वा सर्वा वाञ्छन्तु मा त्वद्राष्ट्रमधि भ्रशत्
paragraphs.translit: viśastvā sarvā vāñchantu mā tvadrāṣṭramadhi bhraśat

paragraphs.text: 2. Be even here; fall not away be like a mountain unremoved.
Stand steadfast here like Indra's self, and hold the kingship in the grasp.
3. This man hath Indra stablished, made secure by strong oblation's power.
May Soma speak a benison, and Brahmanaspati, on him.
paragraphs.original: तस्मै सोमो अधि ब्रवत्तस्मा उ ब्रह्मणस्पतिः
paragraphs.translit: tasmai somo adhi bravattasmā u brahmaṇaspatiḥ

paragraphs.text: 4. Firm is the sky and firm the earth, and steadfast also are these hills.
paragraphs.original: ध्रुवा द्यौर्ध्रुवा पृथिवी ध्रुवासः पर्वता इमे ।
paragraphs.translit: dhruvā dyaurdhruvā pṛthivī dhruvāsaḥ parvatā ime |

paragraphs.text: Steadfast is all this living world, and steadfast is this King of men.
5. Steadfast, may Varuna the King, steadfast, the God Brhaspati,
paragraphs.original: ध्रुवं ते राजा वरुणो ध्रुवं देवो बृहस्पतिः ।
paragraphs.translit: dhruvaṃ te rājā varuṇo dhruvaṃ devo bṛhaspatiḥ |

paragraphs.text: Steadfast, may Indra, steadfast too, may Agni keep thy steadfast reign.
paragraphs.original: ध्रुवं त इन्द्रश्चाग्निश्च राष्ट्रं धारयतां ध्रुवम्
paragraphs.translit: dhruvaṃ ta indraścāgniśca rāṣṭraṃ dhārayatāṃ dhruvam

paragraphs.text: 6. On constant Soma let us think with constant sacrificial gift
And then may Indra make the clans bring tribute unto thee alone.
